Dear Aris,
> Greetings.
> 
> My name is Viorica Bewick. I am your sister, apparently, ~~hopefully~~. Truth be told, Aris, I do not remember you. This might not be a surprise to you, if you know me as well as I can assume. I do not remember a great many things. I got your name from the contract I signed before leaving. My memory may be faulty, but the words I wrote are concrete. Is Aris short for something?
> 
> Some of my fellow travelers tried to tell me of you, from what little they know. I must not have spoken of you often. Were you a secret I had to keep? Were we close, were we distant? All I can be sure of is that we are family, and that I knew you once. Do we have any other family? I seem to have forgotten them too.
> 
> I have left Bywater ~~if not already obvious~~ and I am writing this from the New World, an ocean away. I am not sure if you already knew of this, not sure if I told you. I do not even know if we managed a goodbye. I remember only leaving Bywater for London, and now months later I am here writing this to you. 
> 
> Write me back, if you can? I would like to know you, and maybe the family that I have forgotten. Is the shop okay? Business going on without me? Sorry for the many questions.
> 
> I would say that I miss you, but I do not want to lie. I __wish__ I could miss you. But we cannot miss what we do not remember. 
> 
> I will try to miss you. I will try to remember. 
Sincerely,
Vee.
